UnblockRequest is a user's request, made on the block page, to allow a blocked name. Administrators approve (which adds an allow entry) or deny it; the leader expires and prunes old requests (docs/deploy/blocking-page.md, "Unblock requests").

| | |
|---|---|
| API version | `kudurru.io/v1alpha1` |
| Kind | `UnblockRequest` |
| Scope | Namespaced |
| Resource | `unblockrequests.kudurru.io` |
| Short names | `ubr` |
| Subresources | `status` |

Columns of `kubectl get unblockrequests`:

| Column | Type | Value |
|---|---|---|
| DOMAIN | string | `.spec.domain` |
| CLIENT | string | `.spec.client` |
| STATE | string | `.status.state` |
| AGE | date | `.metadata.creationTimestamp` |

## Spec

UnblockRequestSpec is what a user asked for on the block page. The block page writes it; administrators decide through the API (status).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.block` | `object` | Block is why the name was blocked; nil when the block page did not know. |
| `spec.block.kind` | `string` | Kind is list, service, safesearch, policy (allow-only) or cname.<br>Length: at most 32 |
| `spec.block.list` | `string` | List is the deciding list ("ns/name", "service:&lt;id&gt;", "safesearch:&lt;engine&gt;").<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `spec.block.policy` | `string` | Policy is the policy that applied to the client, "ns/name".<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `spec.block.rule` | `string` | Rule is the matching rule text.<br>Length: at most 1024 |
| `spec.client` | `string` | Client is the requester as querylog.privacy allows recording it: the address (full), its /24 or /48 (prefix), or empty (hidden).<br>Length: at most 64 |
| `spec.clientPrivacy` | `string` | ClientPrivacy says how Client was recorded.<br>One of: `full`, `prefix`, `hidden` |
| `spec.contact` | `string` | Length: at most 254 |
| `spec.domain` | `string` | **Required.** Domain is the blocked name, from the Host header or TLS server name of the block page request (never from the form).<br>Length: 1 to 253 |
| `spec.groups` | `[]string` | Groups are the client's ClientGroups ("ns/name") at request time.<br>Items: at most 16 |
| `spec.node` | `string` | Node is the node whose block page took the request.<br>Length: at most 253 |
| `spec.policies` | `[]string` | Policies are the policies that applied to the client, highest priority first.<br>Items: at most 16 |
| `spec.reason` | `string` | Reason is the user's explanation (plain text).<br>Length: at most 500 |
| `spec.requestedAt` | `string` | RequestedAt is the latest submission (the object's creation is the first); Submissions counts them.<br>Format: `date-time` |
| `spec.requesterName` | `string` | RequesterName and Contact are what the user typed (plain text).<br>Length: at most 100 |
| `spec.submissions` | `integer` | Range: at least 0 |

## Status

UnblockRequestStatus is the decision.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.allow` | `object` | Allow is the allow entry of an approval. |
| `status.allow.added` | `boolean` | Added is true when this approval added Entry (it was not on the list before); only then does expiry remove it. |
| `status.allow.entry` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `status.allow.expiresAt` | `string` | ExpiresAt ends a time-limited approval; nil is permanent.<br>Format: `date-time` |
| `status.allow.group` | `string` | Group is the ClientGroup of a group approval, "ns/name".<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `status.allow.list` | `string` | **Required.** List is the allow BlockList, "ns/name", and Entry the line in its inline "ui" source.<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `status.allow.match` | `string` | **Required.** Match is exact (the name only) or subdomains (the name and below).<br>One of: `exact`, `subdomains` |
| `status.allow.policies` | `[]string` | Policies are the policies the list was attached to by this approval.<br>Items: at most 64 |
| `status.allow.removed` | `string` | Removed is when the expired entry was taken off the list.<br>Format: `date-time` |
| `status.allow.scope` | `string` | **Required.** Scope is everyone (the ui-allow list) or group (ui-allow-&lt;group&gt;).<br>One of: `everyone`, `group` |
| `status.decidedAt` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `status.decidedBy` | `string` | DecidedBy is the administrator ("user:alice") or "system" for expiry; DecidedAt when.<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `status.history` | `[]object` | History holds the earlier decisions when the user asked again, oldest first.<br>Items: at most 20 |
| `status.history[].allow` | `object` | UnblockAllow is the allow entry an approval created. |
| `status.history[].allow.added` | `boolean` | Added is true when this approval added Entry (it was not on the list before); only then does expiry remove it. |
| `status.history[].allow.entry` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `status.history[].allow.expiresAt` | `string` | ExpiresAt ends a time-limited approval; nil is permanent.<br>Format: `date-time` |
| `status.history[].allow.group` | `string` | Group is the ClientGroup of a group approval, "ns/name".<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `status.history[].allow.list` | `string` | **Required.** List is the allow BlockList, "ns/name", and Entry the line in its inline "ui" source.<br>Length: at most 300 |
| `status.history[].allow.match` | `string` | **Required.** Match is exact (the name only) or subdomains (the name and below).<br>One of: `exact`, `subdomains` |
| `status.history[].allow.policies` | `[]string` | Policies are the policies the list was attached to by this approval.<br>Items: at most 64 |
| `status.history[].allow.removed` | `string` | Removed is when the expired entry was taken off the list.<br>Format: `date-time` |
| `status.history[].allow.scope` | `string` | **Required.** Scope is everyone (the ui-allow list) or group (ui-allow-&lt;group&gt;).<br>One of: `everyone`, `group` |
| `status.history[].decidedAt` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `status.history[].decidedBy` | `string` | Length: at most 300 |
| `status.history[].note` | `string` | Length: at most 500 |
| `status.history[].state` | `string` | **Required.** UnblockRequestState is the lifecycle state of an UnblockRequest.<br>One of: `Pending`, `Approved`, `Denied`, `Expired` |
| `status.note` | `string` | Note is the administrator's note, shown to the user on the block page.<br>Length: at most 500 |
| `status.state` | `string` | State is Pending (also when empty), Approved, Denied or Expired.<br>One of: `Pending`, `Approved`, `Denied`, `Expired` |

## Example

`config/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_unblockrequest.yaml`:

```yaml
# Written by the block page, not by hand: a user asked to allow a blocked
# name. Approve or deny it in the dashboard (Requests) or through
# POST /api/v1/unblockrequests/{namespace}/{name}/approve|deny.
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: UnblockRequest
metadata:
  name: ur-3f2a9c1b7d4e6a80
  namespace: default
spec:
  domain: www.example-shop.com
  client: 192.168.1.23
  clientPrivacy: full
  groups: [default/kids]
  policies: [default/kids]
  node: kudurru-0
  requesterName: Sam
  reason: I need it for a school project.
  block:
    kind: list
    list: default/ads
    rule: "||example-shop.com^"
    policy: default/kids
  requestedAt: "2026-10-11T09:30:00Z"
  submissions: 1
```
